todos-harofe.name: Todos the Doctor
todos-harofe.bio: Physician whose expert testimony the Sages cited; the Mishnah quotes him on the Alexandrian practice of removing cows’ wombs.
todos-harofe.prompt: A physician in his 50s with a neatly trimmed greying beard and a composed, observant expression, a small leather case of instruments at his side; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
